methodology.c6_scope: common-support GC x activity cells (n>=20 both domains); does not represent the full datasets

C1_activity_lowbin_delta_mae.definition: between-domain independent bootstrap of mean abs error (external minus internal) in activity bin [0.0,0.2)

C2_activity_highbin_delta_mae.definition: between-domain independent bootstrap of mean abs error (external minus internal) in activity bin [0.8,1.0]

C3_spearman_abs_gc.definition: Spearman(abs_error_RF, GC) on external; within-domain bootstrap CI

joint.definition: common-support GC x activity cells with n >= 20 in BOTH domains; restricted to common support and does not represent the full datasets
